Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Hi,

following situation. Meth A has some Vamp bleeding while Meth B
controls 2 minions. Minion C is a tapped one with a Phased Motion
Detector and Minion D is untapped.

Minion D tries to block. Bleeding Vamp plays true love's face and
Minion D declines to block. Now Minion C tries to block with OtQV.
Does the Phased Motion Detector grant +1 intercept even if at the time
the modifier was played he was not blocking yet?

Name: Phased Motion Detector
[KMW:C, KoT:PB]
Cardtype: Equipment
Electronic equipment.
Once each action, when a vampire plays an action modifier that
requires Chimerstry [chi], Obfuscate [obf] or Obtenebration [obt],
this minion gets +1 intercept for the current action, even if
intercept is not yet needed. A minion may have only one Phased Motion
Detector.

Thanks,

Bernd

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Mar 29, 4:28 am, xcver <xc...@xcver.com> wrote:
> following situation. Meth A has some Vamp bleeding while Meth B
> controls 2 minions. Minion C is a tapped one with a Phased Motion
> Detector and Minion D is untapped.
>
> Minion D tries to block. Bleeding Vamp plays true love's face and
> Minion D declines to block. Now Minion C tries to block with OtQV.
> Does the Phased Motion Detector grant +1 intercept even if at the time
> the modifier was played he was not blocking yet?

It granted it (to minion D) for the current action back when the True
Love's Face was played, yes.
